brandDescription: Award-winning classic and exotic car restoration in Pewaukee, Wisconsin: coachwork, mechanical, paint, interiors and concours preparation.
contentAwardsHeading: We don’t like to toot our own horn,
contentAwardsText: Our award winning restorations speak for themselves. We have experienced success worldwide including The Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance, Amelia Island Concours d’Elegance and Concorso d’Eleganza Villa d’Este in Cernobbio, Italy.
contentPortfolioIntro: Selected restorations from the StreetWorks shop, from bare metal to the concours lawn.
contentJournalIntro: Concours results, open houses and the people behind the work, straight from the shop floor in Pewaukee.
contentCaseStudiesIntro: Every car arrives with a history. These are the full stories of how we brought them back, from the first teardown to the show lawn.
contentLabelsEmptyCategory: The latest post above is the only one in this category.
contentContactText: Have a question about our work? Wondering how we can restore your vehicle to its original glory? We’re happy to answer any questions you have.
